programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Italien painter, Leonardo da Vinci.You will discover his labour with the Joconde, Salvator Mundi, The Cène.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Netherlands painter, Rembrandt.You will discover his labour with The night round, the return of the prodigal son, Danaé.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Francisco de Goya (1746-1828) est un peintre et graveur espagnol. Il introduit plusieurs ruptures stylistiques qui initièrent le romantisme et annoncèrent le début de la peinture contemporaine. Ses œuvres incluent des peintures de chevalet, des peintures murales, des gravures et des dessins. Nous allons découvrir des œuvres telles que “Self-portrait with glasses”, “The sleep of reason produces monsters” ou encore “The young ones”.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Leader of the School of Pont-Aven, Paul Gauguin, the most exotic of French artists, paved the way for modern painting. There were two main themes which marked his work: Brittany and Tahiti. A rebel, he rejected copying reality in favour of exploring more delicate painting techniques. You will discover here the most important milestones in his work: from “Four Breton Girls” to “Tahitian Women on the Beach”, by way of the surprising “Self Portrait with Yellow Christ”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: In 1050, one of the first major pilgrimage churches in the Western world was built at Conques, in the middle of the wild Aveyron landscape. This was the birth of "Romanesque" architecture. The abbey church - i.e., a church belonging to an abbey - at Conques is one of the most important structures built in 11th-century France. Its coherence, its location - a small village in the Rouergue region, far from the main medieval traffic routes - its innovative aspect, its state of preservation and the fact that the relics for which it was built are still in situ, make the church at Conques the best work of art for approaching Romanesque architecture in France. In other words, to try and understand how architecture was made at that time in our history, and to dismantle not only the building itself, but also a number of preconceived ideas about Romanesque art, starting with its very name, which is an intellectual construct of the 19th century, or to put it another way: those who built Conques.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En 2013, la Norvège célébra le 150e anniversaire de la naissance d'Edvard Munch (1863-1944), l'une des figures proéminentes de l'art moderne. Munch 150, coproduite par le Musée national et le Musée Munch, est déjà acclamée comme « l'exposition d'une vie ». L'intérêt général est énorme, comme le témoigne le résultat record de la mise aux enchères publiques de l'un de ses quatre tableaux, Le Cri, soit 120 millions de dollars. Cette présentation vous amènera dans les coulisses de la mise en place de cette exposition, en plus de comprendre une visite guidée de la Norvège qui brossera la biographie de cet homme dont la vie s'est étalée de la moitié du 19ème siècle jusqu'à l'occupation allemande lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Degas : une passion de la perfection
programme.desc: Exhibition on screen nous emmène à travers les rues de Paris puis au cœur d’une superbe exposition au Fitzwilliam Museum de Cambridge, dont l’impressionnante collection d’œuvres de Degas est la plus représentative de Grande-Bretagne. Ayant bénéficié d’un accès exclusif à une grande variété d’œuvres rares, le film raconte l’histoire fascinante de la quête de perfection de Degas à travers l’expérimentation de nouvelles techniques et les leçons apprises en étudiant les grands maîtres.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Le musée d’Orsay, qui fut d'abord une gare construite pour l'Exposition universelle de 1900, abrite la production artistique du monde occidental sur la période de 1848 à 1914. De nombreux courants artistiques y sont présentés : académisme, réalisme, symbolisme, Art nouveau, et bien sur l’impressionnisme avec des œuvres et des artistes incontournables tels que l’Olympia de Manet, le Bal du moulin de la galette de Renoir, l’Etoile de Degas ou le Cirque de Seurat.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En juin 2017, une grande exposition a ouvert à Paris au musée d’Orsay. Pour la première fois, cette exposition a réuni tous les portraits de Cézanne. Cela a été l’occasion d’analyser l’œuvre de Cézanne à l’aide d’experts internationaux et de parcourir les salles de la National Portrait Gallery de Londres et de la National Gallery of Art de Washington.

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc: A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. This film offers a portrait full of contradictions.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Jean-Jacques Lequeu - Builder of fantasies" at the Petit Palais. This exhibition is dedicated to the work of the late 18th century architect Jean-Jacques Lequeu. Despite his profession, he was not known for his constructions, but for his drawings. He made many portraits or drawings of everyday objects, architectural diagrams.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Matisse au MoMA et à la Tate Modern
programme.desc: Découvrez l’œuvre de Matisse à travers les expositions de la Tate Modern à Londres et du MoMA de New York (2014) et profitez de la performance originale de la danseuse étoile du Royal Ballet Zenaida Yanowsky, qui interprète les couleurs et le dynamisme de la peinture de Matisse sur la musique jazz de Courtney Pine. Ponctué d’entrevues avec des experts ainsi que d’images d’archives rares de Matisse au travail, ce documentaire permettra d’apprécier tout particulièrement le dernier chapitre de la carrière du peintre et notamment ses gouaches découpées.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les coachs vocaux et couple marié David et Carrie Grant échangent l'harmonie vocale contre une compétition acharnée d'antiquités. Avec l'aide des experts Will Axon et Mark Stacey, le couple découvre des objets inattendus à vendre lors d’une vente aux enchères dans la campagne du Norfolk.David fait une halte sur un terrain d'herbe en plein cœur de Cambridge, où aujourd'hui les enfants jouent et les chiens se promènent, mais qui était en réalité le berceau du football. Pendant ce temps, Carrie découvre comment Letchworth Garden City a déclenché une révolution dans la conception des villes.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top Italian cooks Antonio Carluccio and Gennaro Contraldo are on a Road Trip around East Anglia. Restaurateurs, writers and old friends the ‘greedy Italians’ will be foraging for antiques in the company of experts David Harper and James Braxton. Watch out for some ‘explosive’ bargaining and an extremely tasty risotto! When he’s not shopping Antonio learns about the brave fisherman of Suffolk who saved mariners’ lives while risking their own. And, Gennaro has a trip to take a peek at a very special bird.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London. Jennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.And, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Le rockeur progressif Rick Wakeman et son grand ami Ian Lavender, célèbre pour son rôle de Pike dans Dad’s Army, s’offrent une joyeuse virée sur les routes secondaires du Norfolk. Accompagnés des experts Raj Bisram et David Harper, ces deux chasseurs d’antiquités sillonnent le comté à la recherche de trésors à vendre aux enchères à Nottingham.Rick découvre d’anciens graffitis médiévaux cachés dans la cathédrale de Norwich, tandis qu’Ian fait un détour vers le nord du Norfolk pour admirer la plus grande collection de soldats miniatures au monde.Mais un sage vieil homme japonais aidera-t-il Ian à triompher aux enchères ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les coachs vocaux et couple marié David et Carrie Grant échangent l'harmonie vocale contre une compétition acharnée d'antiquités. Pendant ce temps, Carrie découvre comment Letchworth Garden City a déclenché une révolution dans la conception des villes.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Two favourite Blue Peter presenters Sarah Greene and Peter Duncan are in the company of Natasha Raskin and Catherine Southon as they hunt for antiques around Surrey, Hertfordshire and North West London. Peter detours to learn how hockey became a popular sport the world over while keen aviator Sarah sees how the Battle of Britain was won. An incredible haul of antiques, including chimney pots, Pinocchio and a pair of African fertility figures, go under the gavel at an auction in Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.desc: L'icône de la pop et actrice Claire Grogan retrouve son compatriote de Glasgow, l’acteur Alex Norton de Taggart, pour une quête de trésors antiques lucratifs. Anita Manning et Paul Laidlaw sont là pour leur prodiguer leurs conseils d’experts.Anita et Alex se retrouvent embarqués dans un Boat Trip d'antiquités, évoquant leurs souvenirs d'enfance sur le Clyde. Pendant ce temps, Claire et Paul découvrent de près à quoi ressemblait le château de Stirling au XVIe siècle.Le résultat de la vente aux enchères à Ayr dépendra d’une dame nue.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In this episode, the two candidates Stéphany Mora and Harleena will compete on an imposed theme. Today, the theme is vineyards. They will have one hour to take the best picture possible. Let’s see who will win.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Gutenberg est considéré comme le père de l’imprimerie moderne. La petite histoire raconte qu’il se serait inspiré du pressoir à raisin utilisé par les vignerons pour inventer sa machine. De cette anecdote historique, deux artistes ont entrepris d’éditer un livre qui étanchera la soif de n’importe quel lecteur gourmand. Dans cet épisode, nous rencontrerons Luz et Anaïs, deux artistes opposées et absolument complémentaires.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a British painter, William Turner.You will discover his labour with London from greenwich park, child hairdo’s pilgrimage, Snow storm.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Eugene Delacroix.You will discover his labour with The barque of Dante, Portrait of Aspasie, The assassination of the bishop of liege.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Antonio Canal, known as Canaletto, and Francesco Guardi are the best known 18th century painters of the urban Venetian landscape. In minute detail, they painted iconic views of the Venetian Republic, destined for rich foreign visitors. “Maria della Salute from the Grand Canal in Venice” by Canaletto and “Venice: Piazza San Marco” by Guardi followed this trend. Later Venice also inspired Paul Signac’s “The Green Veil, Venice”. Go on a voyage of discovery...Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Art Quiz
programme.desc: Test your knowledge and your memory in fine arts, architecture, photography, street art and a dozen other topics with our Art Quiz popups !

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: L'usine Menier à Noisiel fut entre 1870 et 1914 la plus grande chocolaterie du monde. Mais ce fut aussi et surtout une usine pionnière en matière d'innovation architecturale. Son architecture de fer puis de béton voulait symboliser la puissance et la modernité de l'entreprise. Ses trois bâtiments majeurs, le moulin Saulnier, la première construction à charpente entièrement métallique du monde, la Halle Eiffel et la Cathédrale racontent à leur manière l'âge d'or de l'architecture industrielle.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Au début des années 90, le nouveau maire de Sendai développe le projet d’une médiathèque, un type de bâtiment jusqu’alors inconnu au Japon. Son architecte Toyo ito rompt avec les postulats de l’architecture moderne du 20 ème siècle : la médiathèque et son « espace sans barrières » est un premier pas vers une architecture immatérielle et évanescente, laissant toute sa place à l’éphémère.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Vandalised, stolen, cut into pieces, melted down and resold for a few thousand euros, even though they are worth millions: sculptures. On the night of 30–31 March 1999, whilst this park in the 6th arrondissement was closed to the public, individuals stole the sculpture of Picasso’s former muse and lover, Dora Maar: ‘Head of a Woman’, an 80-centimetre-tall bronze weighing 80 kilos. Two years later, in a town hall in the Paris suburbs, it stood proudly on the staircase: ‘Do you realise you’ve got a Picasso in your building?’ exclaimed an antique dealer who had come to visit the château. Indeed, the town hall had found a ‘large stone’ buried on a plot of land, had it cleaned, thought it was beautiful and displayed it in their château, unaware that it was a sculpture by Picasso….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: Alley of Poplars by Sisley, Nice Museum of Fine Arts
programme.desc: Sisley was a British Impressionist painter, closely associated with Renoir and Monet. On 20 June 1978, at 8.30 pm, a truck was stolen. Inside were around ten masterpieces worth 1.5 billion francs. The transport company responsible for returning the works following a loan had made no security arrangements. On 21 September 1998, ‘The Avenue of Poplars’ was stolen once again. This time, it was the curator of the Musée des Beaux-Arts in Nice, Jean Fornéris, who staged his own abduction! Finally, on Sunday 5 August 2007, five masked and armed men held up staff at the Nice museum to steal four paintings, including the Sisley. It was not until 2008, with the help of the FBI – which was also searching for works stolen from the Boston Museum – that the thieves were arrested.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: Looting of the Gentili Di Giuseppe Collection
programme.desc: Federico Gentili di Giuseppe was a Jewish businessman of Italian origin with a passion for art. On his death in 1940, he bequeathed a collection of 150 paintings to his two children, Marcel and Adriana, who had become naturalised French citizens. In 1941, Maître Moulin auctioned off these paintings under questionable circumstances. This marked the beginning of a legal battle waged by the Gentili di Giuseppe heirs, which was to last nearly 50 years.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the night of 17–18 October 1984, three criminals broke into the municipal museum in Semur-en-Auxois, which was not fitted with an alarm system. The joint investigation by the French and Japanese police revealed links between the Parisian underworld and the Japanese Yakuza mafia. Indeed, Shinchi Fujikuma, a Japanese gangster, had met two members of the Aubervilliers gang, Philippe-Emile Jamin and Youssef Khimoun, whilst serving time in a French prison. In 1987, the French managed to return from Japan with four of the five stolen paintings. The last one, *The Portrait of Mrs Baudot*, remained with its new owner, in accordance with the principle of ‘good faith’ guaranteed by Japanese law.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vermeer and music - the art of love and leisure
programme.desc: La National Gallery de Londres propose un nouveau regard sur l'un des plus grands artistes de tous les temps, Johannes Vermeer. Il est le peintre de la célèbre toile “La Jeune Fille à la perle”. Dans une exposition intitulée "Vermeer et la musique : L'art de l'amour et des loisirs

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso est l’un des plus grands artistes au monde, et jusqu’à sa mort en 1973, il était le plus prolifique. Comment tout a commencé ? Comment s’est construit Picasso ? Après avoir été trop longtemps ignorées, il est temps de se concentrer sur les jeunes années de l’artiste et son éducation qui lui ont permis d’accomplir l’extraordinaire. Trois villes ont joué un rôle-clé : Malaga, Barcelone et Paris. "Le jeune Picasso" les traverse et explore leur influence sur l’artiste, en analysant des œuvres spécifiques de ses débuts.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Rembrandt at the National Gallery, London & Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam
programme.desc: Every Rembrandt exhibition is eagerly awaited, but this exhibition organized by London's National Gallery and Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum was an unprecedented event. The documentary highlights the historic Rembrandt exhibition, while tracing his life. Rembrandt is one of the greatest artists who ever lived, and this deeply moving documentary seeks to explore the truth about the man behind the legend.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Léonard à la National Gallery de Londres
programme.desc: Un événement remarquable s'est produit à la National Gallery de Londres lorsque la plus grande collection jamais constituée de peintures de Léonard de Vinci a été réunie dans une exposition unique : Léonard de Vinci : peintre à la cour de Milan. Léonard est reconnu comme étant peut-être le plus grand peintre et sculpteur de tous les temps, mais ses talents ne s'arrêtaient pas là. Ce film raconte sa vie et s'étend sur Léonard le visionnaire, Léonard l'inventeur. Depuis l'endroit où il a vécu ses dernières années au Château du Clos Lucé en France, nous verrons que Léonard de Vinci était peut-être l'incarnation même de l'esprit de la Renaissance.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Les impressionnistes - et l'homme qui les a créés
programme.desc: Ce sont les artistes les plus populaires du monde. Les œuvres de Cézanne, Monet, Degas et leurs compatriotes représentent des richesses inestimables. Mais qui étaient-ils vraiment ? Comment et pourquoi ont-ils révolutionné l’histoire de l’art ? Qu’est-ce qui se cache derrière leur succès intemporel ? Pour répondre à ces questions, le documentaire a obtenu un accès unique à une grande exposition mettant l’accent sur le collectionneur d’art parisien du 19ème siècle, Paul Durand-Ruel, l’expert des Impressionnistes qui prit la décision courageuse d’exposer les Impressionnistes à New York en 1886 et ainsi introduire la société américaine à la peinture française moderne.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'humoriste et animateur Jim Moir et sa femme Nancy Sorrell partent en road trip dans le Kent aujourd'hui.Mieux connu sous le nom de Vic Reeves, Jim apporte sa touche d'humour unique à l'achat d'antiquités. De son côté, Nancy, mannequin et présentatrice télé, sait aussi marchander et elle est très compétitive ! Le couple est accompagné par les experts Charlie Ross et Thomas Plant.Soyez attentif au don surprenant de Jim pour deviner l’âge de presque tout, à Dixon traversant les chutes du Niagara et à une leçon de navigation par longitude.Et surtout, la mystérieuse Mme Parker fera-t-elle son apparition à la vente aux enchères ?

programme.title: Halloween Special evening
programme.desc: A Halloween evening blending nightmarish visions with macabre fascination. Begin by immersing yourself in the strange and visionary world of Hieronymus Bosch through the incredible and ambitious collection of his paintings and drawings: “Visions of Genius” at the Noordbrabants Museum. Then step into the realm of the bizarre with the unsettling art of three artists who sculpt death using taxidermy in their works. A dual journey to the frontiers of the strange.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: 200 years after it opened and a century after acquiring its first Van Gogh works, the National Gallery hosted the largest Van Gogh exhibition ever held in the UK (September 14, 2024 to January 19, 2025). The exhibition was a huge success, unanimously praised by the press, and tickets sold out quickly, making this film the only way to see what Forbes called a “once-in-a-lifetime exhibition.”Discover the passion that drove one of the world's most beloved artists to revolutionize art. Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers rewrites history and celebrates Van Gogh's genius without exploiting his suffering, allowing audiences to truly understand this iconic artist in a whole new way...

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.What led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Après le tsunami de mars 2011 au Japon, un collectif d’architectes animé par Toyo Ito lança le projet des maisons pour tous, des lieux collectifs pour les habitants des villes dévastées. Trois jeunes architectes, Su Fujimoto, Kumiko Inui, Akihisa Hirata, construisent une de ces maisons à Rikuzentakata. Utilisant les arbres de la forêt détruite, ils créent une image de maison avec un toit pointu, transpercé par 19 troncs. S’enroulant autour des espaces intérieurs, une promenade alterne les escaliers et les terrasses, face au paysage : le quadrillage des rues, la seule trace de la ville disparue. Conçue en six mois, construite en cinq mois, la maison obtient le Lion d’Or à la Biennale de Venise en 2012.

programme.desc: It's the long-awaited day of the grand final. But before seeing the reaction of the owners and finding out their scores, each candidate will find out what the other contestants thought of their choice in terms of decoration. And it's Armand who will be the first to join our decorating expert, Valérie Damidot, in the workshop. Armand is about to discover the criticisms of his opponents. We hope for his sake that his heart is in the right place.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Direction le Loir-et-Cher pour une chasse à courre encadrée par les équipes de l’ONCFS. Prenons ensuite la route des Vosges pour cuisiner aux côtés de Mauricette une savoureuse gigue de cerf. Allons à la rencontre de Pierre en Côte d’Or où il fabrique des trompes de chasse, un outil indispensable à la vénerie. Julie retrouvera aussi deux chasseurs girondins pour une après-midi de chasse à la tonne dès plus originale avant de rejoindre Joël en Aquitaine pour une autre recette de gibier à plume. Nous parlerons ensuite avec Laurent du métier de piqueux : ce dresseur de chiens destinés à la vénerie. Cette fois-ci ce sera Frédéric Robert qui nous concoctera une recette de lièvre frotté au cacao et cuit dans un sarcophage d’argile.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo puts Normandy in the spotlight! With the region's president, Hervé Morin, she prepares apples poached in cinnamon syrup, as well as mussels... in her own way.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Avec son amie Myriam, Luana Belmondo prépare deux recettes à base de safran. Au programme : orecchiette (petites pâtes italiennes) avec de la saucisse, et lotte au citron confit avec sa purée d’asperges.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Défendre l’eau c’est défendre la vie - Partie 1
programme.desc: The oceans cover more than 70% of the Earth's surface. The sea is the largest natural environment on our planet and remains virtually unexploited. In Brittany, in the Seven Islands. Then in the Bay of Saint-Brieuc, in the middle of a sea of green algae. In Brittany, intensive agriculture has developed over the last thirty years. In New Caledonia, the coral reef is the second largest in the world and could be threatened by the construction of a nickel mine. In Normandy, in the Botanical Garden of Vauville, an extraordinary garden has plants from all over the world. Also in the Archipelago of Chausey in Normandy with the highest tides in Europe. Or the Mont Saint Michel. As a result of silting up and man-made works, the Mont was no longer an island. In Italy, in Venice, on the verge of drowning, major development work, industrialisation and tourism have upset the environment. In New Caledonia, flying over the heart of Voh is surrounded by the largest lagoon in the world. 24,000 km2 prot.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The call of the Forest is about discovering places but above all it is about meeting those who protect this priceless heritage. Forests are essential to mankind. They capture CO2, promote the formation of clouds and therefore rain, protect the soil from erosion and provide a habitat for wildlife. From Madagascar, to France, to Cameroon, or even Eritrea, Yann Arthus-Bertrand sets out to discover the most beautiful forests, those who live in them, those who protect them and those who live off them.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Bangladesh - Partie 2
programme.desc: With Bangladesh as a running thread, Yann Arthus-Bertrand meets several people who have changed their lives to dedicate themselves to a major project. In Bangladesh, Yves and Runa Marre have created the Friendship Foundation. Among other things, they’ve created a floating hospital installed on an old barge bought in France. Julie Andersen, an ex-advertising executive from New York, has come to South Africa to defend sharks with her Shark Angels Foundation. In North India, Kartik Satyanarayan is helping to stop the dreadful exploitation of the lippus bears (dancing bears). He’s created Wildlife SOS, a preserve to rehabilitate the bears that have been rescued and to give work to the men of the tribe who were traditionally bear tamers and entertainers.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Sénégal - Partie 1
programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Honey was the first sweet condiment in history! It has also been known and consumed as a remedy since Antiquity. In France, we find an infinite variety of honey: acacia, chestnut, fir, rosemary, orange, spruce, oak, linden or lavender... We'll cross forests, fields and even towns, as bees also forage in urbanized areas. We'll then cook up emblematic recipes like Vercel gingerbread. Finally, we'll discover the European dark bee. Protecting this 80-million-year-old bee has become the spearhead of some passionate beekeepers.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

Like us, Luana Belmondo hates throwing things away. She knows all about waste-free cooking and has mastered the art. She shows us how to reinvent boiled or steamed potatoes as something other than mashed potatoes. On the program: potato soufflé with paprika and vegetable gratin with curry.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen

programme.desc: Direction le Loir-et-Cher pour une chasse à courre encadrée par les équipes de l’ONCFS. Prenons ensuite la route des Vosges pour cuisiner aux côtés de Mauricette une savoureuse gigue de cerf. Allons à la rencontre de Pierre en Côte d’Or où il fabrique des trompes de chasse, un outil indispensable à la vénerie. Julie retrouvera aussi deux chasseurs girondins pour une après-midi de chasse à la tonne dès plus originale avant de rejoindre Joël en Aquitaine pour une autre recette de gibier à plume. Nous parlerons ensuite avec Laurent du métier de piqueux : ce dresseur de chiens destinés à la vénerie. Cette fois-ci ce sera Frédéric Robert qui nous concoctera une recette de lièvre frotté au cacao et cuit dans un sarcophage d’argile.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints
programme.desc: If the Atlantis Bahamas isn’t on your family's bucket list - it should be! We’ll show you why as each family member ticks off their dream adventure that also gives back. Proving this big resort has an even bigger heart.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints
programme.desc: Sometimes exploring the road less traveled gives you the biggest adventure. In this episode, we escape the city buzz and opt for a quieter life on a Texas dude ranch. Taking time to appreciate the beauty in history, animals and quality time as a family.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints
programme.desc: Join us on an epic adventure to a remote private island in Belize. As we spend our days catching lobsters, diving the worldclass reef and enjoying coconuts straight from the tree.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints
programme.desc: We travel to an island resort in Fiji known for it’s daring shark encounters! To hear and see first hand the amazing conservation work they’re doing. Along the way we meet the local school kids and learn about how they’re helping protect the reef.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes us on a journey of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. On her journey, Julie will introduce us to the famous black pepper.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous donne rendez-vous à Bordeaux après avoir arpenté le pays de Blaye, visité deux fois le bassin et parcouru les terres du Libournais à deux reprises, il fallait bien s’arrêter un jour dans la capitale du Bordelais ! N’y-a-t-il pas meilleure saison que le mois de septembre pour découvrir la perle d’Aquitaine, plus souvent appelée « Cité du vin » ? Julie donne rendez-vous à ces habitants pour découvrir les traditions mais aussi les projets plus récents de cette ville chargée d’Histoire et de gastronomie.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Avec son amie Myriam, Luana Belmondo prépare deux recettes à base de safran. Au programme : orecchiette (petites pâtes italiennes) avec de la saucisse, et lotte au citron confit avec sa purée d’asperges.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Nous entamerons ce périple près de la Rochelle pour en apprendre un peu plus sur l’élevage des fameuses moules de bouchot mais aussi une technique bien particulière pour les cuisiner. Nous partirons ensuite pour un tour de France des meilleures huîtres : direction Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier et enfin Oléron pour connaître les différentes méthodes d’élevage et s’y retrouver un peu plus parmi toutes les espèces de l’hexagone. Julie cuisinera une fricassée de berniques, les petits chapeaux chinois qui recouvrent les rochers du littoral mais aussi des palourdes roses méconnues du grand public. Nous poursuivrons notre route dans le Finistère pour rencontrer Sylvain, le seul éleveur d’ormeau du pays puis à Méru où se trouve encore des ateliers magnifiant ce sublime matériau. Le Chef Jean-Marie Baudic nous cuisine les coquilles Saint-Jacques comme personne.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie prend la direction de la Bourgogne pour découvrir des races anciennes de volaille réintroduites en France grâce au travail de l’éleveur Fred Ménager. Nous nous rapprocherons ensuite de l’Auvergne pour découvrir comment est attribué le fameux Label Rouge et le rôle des organismes certificateurs … car il est important de savoir ce qui atterri dans nos assiettes. Julie se rendra aussi dans la Drôme pour cuisiner de la pintade avant de se diriger vers le Périgord pour préparer un civet de dindon. Installée dans sa petite Micheline, Julie remontera ensuite vers le centre pour découvrir un étonnant fabricant de mouche qui utilise des plumes de coqs !

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The call of the Forest is about discovering places but above all it is about meeting those who protect this priceless heritage. Forests are essential to mankind. They capture CO2, promote the formation of clouds and therefore rain, protect the soil from erosion and provide a habitat for wildlife. From Madagascar, to France, to Cameroon, or even Eritrea, Yann Arthus-Bertrand sets out to discover the most beautiful forests, those who live in them, those who protect them and those who live off them.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Sénégal - Partie 1
programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her Italian friend Alessandra Pierini are preparing a pasta party. They'll be cooking pesto and sharing their tips on how to get it right. They'll also be making pasta saporita, full of color and flavor!

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her pastry chef friend Laurent Favre-Mot prepare desserts from our childhood. On the program: panettone in French toast, and torta della nonna with lemon cream and pine nuts, a typical Italian dessert!

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.desc: Paracetamol, ibuprofen or aspirin… Painkillers are everywhere in our medicine cabinets. These treatments are so commonplace that we all too often forget the dangers they pose. First and foremost is paracetamol. Fourteen packets are sold every second in France. Often perceived as harmless, paracetamol is extremely toxic in the event of an overdose. For the 10 million French people who suffer from chronic pain, conventional painkillers are no longer sufficient, and it is often necessary to resort to painkillers derived from morphine and opium. The problem is that these medicines, such as Tramadol, can lead to serious addiction. Over the past ten years, the use of these medicines has risen sharply in France, causing concern amongst health authorities as these painkillers are wreaking havoc in the United States. Every day, 130 Americans die from an opioid-related overdose, which has become the leading cause of preventable death among people under the age of 50, far ahead of road traffic ac.

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.desc: In France, 30 per cent of adults and 50 per cent of older people are affected by high blood pressure. This excessively high blood pressure in the arteries can lead to strokes, heart attacks, kidney failure or dementia.The World Health Organisation ranks high blood pressure, known as the ‘silent killer’, as the second greatest health risk, just behind smoking. Being overweight, a lack of physical activity, smoking, a diet that is too high in salt and stress are all contributing factors.More often than not, high blood pressure presents no symptoms, making it difficult to detect. Whilst many patients are unaware that they have high blood pressure, conversely, others are wrongly classified as ‘sick’.This is because blood pressure fluctuates constantly and can lead to misdiagnosis. A bout of stress or physical exertion can cause blood pressure to rise. Another factor that can skew the reading is the ‘white coat’ effect, linked to the stress of the consultation. programme.desc: Ekvator strekker seg 4000 kilometer over det afrikanske kontinentet. Artene som finnes her, er like mangfoldige som landskapet. Hvert år etterfølges flommen av sult, men dyrene har tilpasset seg til omgivelsene. Dette er Ekvatorial-Afrika, evolusjonens hjerte.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Korallrevene i Asia-Stillehavsregionen er de mest mangfoldige i hele verden. Og de fantastiske skapningene i havets regnskog er avhengige av hverandre for å overleve.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Ecuadorianske Andes krysser ekvator, og området har et enormt biologisk mangfold. Jungeldyr og fjellarter bor side om side, og alle har tilpasset seg til et ekstremt liv i fjellene.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Vanskelige saker trenger PVS-behandling under en nifs halloween-sesong! Dr. Pol hjelper et hengebuksvin som ble angrepet av to hunder. En etterkommer av løpshestsekretariatet har et problematisk øreproblem. En fødende labrador bringer en gjeng bedårende valper til verden. Og dr. Pol hjelper en søt kattunge med å finne et nytt hjem.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Dyrlege Pol tilbyr lindring til en blind jack russel og hjelper en melkeku som sliter med en fødsel. Senere prøver den gode legen å få fotfeste etter at en amper okse sender ham opp i lufta. Et hengebuksvin på over 110 kilo ypper seg på dr. Lisa, mens dr. Nicole sliter med en energisk husky. Dr. Brenda feirer høytiden med en fallskjermhoppende nisse og alvene hans.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Flere hundre kilometer utenfor kysten av Ecuador finnes det en gruppe vulkanøyer som huser noen av de merkeligste livsformene som finnes. Dette er Galapagosøyene, som steg opp fra havet for over 20 millioner år siden. Livet har utviklet seg i isolasjon og ført til en rekke fantastiske skapninger, der mange bare finnes her.

programme.title: Hidden Wonders of Europe
programme.desc: Det karrige landskapet på Den iberiske halvøy inneholder snøkledde fjelltopper, store skoger med korkeik og Europas eneste tåkeskog. I de unike habitatene kjemper arter som bare finnes her for å overleve. Pyreneersteinbukkene duellerer om hunnene, ternene må unngå rovdyrene i havet og berberapene boltrer seg på Gibraltar.

programme.title: Hidden Wonders of Europe
programme.desc: Europe’s ancient landscapes have virtually disappeared, but some stretches remain. A rich mosaic of habitats still cover the country of Poland. Lush forests, vast lowlands and mountain peaks all team with life. But the wildlife here has to fight to survive. Sea eagles battle over breakfast, seasoned hunters adapt to extreme conditions, and a crafty caterpillar pulls off the ultimate heist.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin drar til den australske savannen på jakt etter landets mest formidable skapninger. Først møter han Australias største rovfugl, en kilehaleørn, og Australias mest aggressive slange, kysttaipanen. Senere står han ansikt til ansikt med en krageagam og dens fascinerende forsvarsmekanismer.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Sommeren byr på overflod, men i kappløpet om å utnytte den korte varme årstiden følger også konkurranse, aggresjon og fare. Høyt oppe på fjellengene kjemper alpemurmeldyrene om de beste hiene der de kan oppfostre ungene sine. Men klarer de å unnslippe sultne bjørner? Bjørnungene i Karpatene vokser raskt, men trues av voksne hannbjørner som vil kvitte seg med rivalenes avkom. Klarer binnene å beskytte dem med sine smarte strategier? Flokker av europeisk bison dundrer gjennom de gamle skogene på jakt etter mat og vann. De er et av de fremste eksemplene på vellykket reintroduksjon, fordi tråkkene deres skaper liv i hele skogen og gir gode vilkår for milliarder av insekter. Insektene søker videre til kronhjortflokkene etter næring. Plaget av stikkende insekter trekker hjortene opp i fjellene for å slippe dem, men der risikerer de i stedet å bli bytte for sjeldne villkatter.

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike
programme.desc: Det er vinter for præriehundene i New Mexico. Carl og ungene forbereder seg på å gå i hi, men en uventet allianse mellom rovdyrene i området har satt villhundene i stor fare.

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike
programme.sub-title: Den gode, den onde og den kosete
programme.desc: Endelig har man varmt vær i nordre New Mexico, og det betyr at paringstiden er i gang. På slettene må Furgie kjempe mot Brutus igjen om retten til å pare seg med en tispe i alfahundens territorium.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Etter en desperat leting gjenforenes Kio og Summer med brødrene, men livet i utkanten av flokkens territorium er nådeløst. Summer sliter med å jakte for de uerfarne sønnene og forberede dem på et liv alene, og kampen for å overleve tærer på. Når et lett bytte blir for fristende, får det konsekvenser som forandrer Kios liv for alltid. Han tvinges til å bli selvstendig lenge før tiden, og nå må Kio og brødrene hans lære å overleve på egen hånd.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Høsten forvandler Karpatenes fjellsider til et bølgende teppe av bronse, ravgult og gull. Skogene fylles av kronhjortenes mektige brøl, som varsler kampen om retten til å samle en flokk med hinder. Oppgjørene er brutale, og de svekkede taperne blir et lett bytte for ulveflokker på jakt etter et enkelt måltid. For bjørnene gjelder det å fråtse i bær og nøtter for å legge på seg før vinterdvalen. Til tross for sin enorme størrelse klatrer de opp bøke- og furustammer for å nå de saftigste nøttene i trekronene. De går også inn på menneskenes åkere for å forsyne seg av mais. De gjør nesten hva som helst for å stille sulten. Alle disse storslåtte dyrenes overlevelse avhenger av de gamle skogene. De gamle trærne binder skadelig karbon fra atmosfæren og bidrar til å regulere jordas klima, en livsviktig funksjon for alt liv.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Når dyrene er i nød, trår veterinærene til. En hund som har blitt påkjørt må opereres med det samme, og valpesjekken gir dr. Nicole en stor overraskelse. Dr. Lisa behandler en ku med et stort sår i beinet samt en hund som ble angrepet. Dr. Pol tar imot to hunder med magebesvær og hjelper en merr med fødselen.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Dr. Pol drar for å behandle Louella, en stor purke som er for syk til å amme de 15 grisungene sine. Dr. Lisa evaluerer en nyfødt foles ustødige gange og syr beinet til ei hoppe. Deretter undersøker dr. Brenda en vallak som viser tegn på en nevrologisk sykdom. Dyrlegene behandler også pyreneervalper, søte kattunger, og en schæfer og en 75-kilos rottweiler med beinskader.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Når en syk hund knapt kan gå, er PVS-veterinærene på saken.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: I de øde skogene i Sentral-Kina finnes det noen spesielle og høylytte primater. Vi følger en unge blant stumpneseapene gjennom dens første leveår, der hun lærer om skogen og hva som kreves for å overleve.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: Livet er hardt på de store gresslettene i Kina. Området herjes av voldsomme stormer året gjennom så innbyggerne må være tilpasningsdyktige og hardføre for å overleve her. Under de tre sommermånedene må dyrene utnytte muligheten til å oppdra ungene før høsten og vinteren setter inn.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: Bambusskogen i Kina er full av hemmeligheter og overraskelser, som den legendariske kjempepandaen, rødpanda, tibetmakak og uvanlige skapninger som blomstermantis, flaggermus og emeipadder. Alle har funnet seg til rette i det store gressriket.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: Sør i Yunnan-provinsen i Kina finnes det en unik jungel med et svært mangfoldig dyreliv. Vi får se primater og bjørner, flaggermus og bier, elefanter og sommerfugllarver.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: Teamet følger en hengiven snøleopardmor som lærer ungene hvordan de skal overleve, en sandrev må beskytte ungene mot en mektig jeger og vi får se de utrolige egenskapene til en av verdens minste katter.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Bli med inn i Australias skoger og møt noen av de fascinerende dyreungene som vokser opp her. Følg koalaungene fra den første trygge tiden i moras pung til de begynner å klatre og utforske omgivelsene. Se når flygehundungene lærer å fly, mens kokaburraungene finner stemmen sin og våger seg ut av reiret. I regnskogene i Queensland titter sjeldne trekenguruunger fram fra moras pung, mens stripete kasuarkyllinger lærer det de trenger for å overleve av sin omsorgsfulle far. Vi møter også pungrotter, og til og med små larver, som vokser og utvikler seg og forbereder seg på livet på egen hånd. Gjennom fascinerende dyreatferd og nære familiehistorier får vi oppleve utfordringene, overraskelsene og de avgjørende stegene på veien mot et selvstendig liv for de yngste beboerne i Australias skoger.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Bli med til Australias unike øyer og møt noen av dyreungene som vokser opp der. Følg nyklekte grønne havskilpadder på den farefulle ferden fra reiret på stranden til havet, pelsselunger som lærer å svømme langs fjellkyster, og quokkaunger som tar sine første hopp ved moras side. På Tasmania kommer livlige tasmanske djevelunger ut av moras pung, klare til å utforske verden. Langt mot sør, på den subantarktiske Macquarieøya, møter dunete kongepingvinunger, sjøelefantunger og unge albatrosser utfordringene ved å vokse opp i et karrig og forblåst landskap. Gjennom fascinerende dyreatferd, overraskende fakta og nære familieøyeblikk følger vi den utrolige utviklingen fra sårbare nyfødte til unge dyr som er klare til å møte livet på egen hånd.

programme.title: Afrikas farlige rike
programme.desc: Sør-Afrikas vestkyst er en tøff verden preget av det kalde vannet i Stillehavet og herjet av kraftig vind.

programme.title: Dyrebabyhjelpen
programme.desc: Naturverner Giles Clark reiser til Sør-Afrika og møter to ivrige grupper som tar vare på foreldreløse ville dyr. Ved Umoya Khulula Wildlife Centre hjelper Giles en foreldreløs pangolinbaby med å lære viktige ferdigheter for livet i det fri. Senere, på et senter for rehabilitering av elefanter, møter Clark en babyelefant i trøbbel som er på vei til å få sin egen flokk.

programme.title: Car S.O.S
programme.desc: Tim og Fuzz skal jobbe med en Ford Cortina Mk3 fra 1973. Det var en bestselger i Storbritannia, men nå er den en sjeldenhet. Bilen eies av 53-åringen Bobby, som har prøvd å få stoltheten tilbake på veien i over 20 år. Men flere år med dårlig helse har ført til at drømmen aldri har blitt realisert, så Car SOS-teamet vil hjelpe ham.

programme.title: 2. verdenskrig: Helvete under vann
programme.desc: Under den fjerde krigspatruljen blir en ubåt skadet av angrep fra dypet og bomber fra luften, noe som tvinger den ned til knusende dybde. En væpnet torpedo setter seg fast, og en sanitetssoldat må utføre en nødoperasjon ved siden av en japansk festning. Oppdraget deres kan hjelpe til med å snu kampen i de alliertes favør. De må bare overleve det først.

programme.title: Egypts tapte skatter
programme.desc: Arkeologer undersøker dronningene i antikkens Egypt, og går inn i en uutforsket pyramide for første gang på over 4000 år.

programme.title: Egypts tapte skatter
programme.desc: Arkeologer avslører hvordan gravrøvere plyndret pyramidene og gravkamrene fra oldtidens Egypt og ledetrådene de etterlot seg. I en nekropolis for eliten etterforsker de et elegant, nedsenket gravkammer, robbet og gjenbrukt i hundrevis av år. De utforsker et av oldtidsverdenens frekkeste ran, et dristig tyveri i et gigantisk og svært beskyttet mastaba-gravkammer. Og ved Egypts eldre pyramide, avslører de hvordan byggearbeidere konstruerte forseggjorte forsvar for å beskytte skattene på innsiden.

programme.title: Hvordan fange en smugler
programme.desc: HSI-agenter i Orange County utfører 3 undercover-narkostikk som fører til flere arrestasjoner og beslag av crystal meth, fentanyl og skytevåpen. JFK Agriculture Specialists beslaglegger og ødelegger forbudte matvarer. CBP i Rio Grande Valley gjennomsøker kjøretøyer som krysser grensen og oppdager bunter med kokain gjemt under baksetet på en SUV.

programme.title: Hvordan fange en smugler
programme.desc: Fra himmelen over San Diego overvåker Homeland Security Investigations flere nivåer av kartellet, og beslaglegger en last på to millioner dollar med narkotika. Tollvesenet og grensepatruljens valuta K9 snuser opp titusenvis i skjulte kontanter i Atlanta. Og i New York avdekker kultureiendomsteamet en smuglerpakke med bøker som viser seg å være over 500 år gamle.

programme.title: Hemmeligheter på havets bunn
programme.desc: I århundrer har skatteskip seilte gjennom verdenshavene, fulle av sølv, gull og edelstener. Mange av dem ligger uoppdaget på havbunnen. Ved hjelp av den nyeste undervannsskanningsteknologien og datagrafikk går marinarkeologer og skattejegere på jakt etter sunkne skatter. Tøming av havene avdekker de rikeste vrakene som noen gang er funnet.

programme.title: Car S.O.S
programme.desc: Car S.O.S går i gang med en Suzuki Jimny 4x4 fra 2002, som eies av en pensjonert NHS-sykepleier og hengiven mor, Joanna. Den nye bilen var en gave fra faren hennes like før han døde, og er full av utallige minner. Dessverre har en feil med girkassa som ikke en gang Suzuki kan fikse gjort at bilen ikke er kjørbar. Det blir en kamp mot tiden når teamet må fikse girkassa og restaurere bilen, samtidig som de avdekker hvorfor Jimny har blitt et skikkelig ikon for mange.

programme.title: Car S.O.S
programme.desc: Car S.O.S går i gang med en Ferrari 308 GTS fra 1984, en bil som ble berømt på grunn av det populære 80-tallsshowet Magnum P.I. bilen ble kjøpt av pensjonert politisersjant John til 50-årsdagen, men restaureringen ble satt på vent da den hengivne trebarnsfaren brukte tiden sin på å hjelpe familien og andre rundt ham. Kan gutta redde denne sjeldne juvelen, og vil en skeptisk Fuzz falle for hestens tiltrekningkraft.

programme.title: Skjulte hemmeligheter fra 2. verdenskrig
programme.desc: De allierte marsjerte mot Roma, men stoppet opp midt i Italias fjellandskap. Pete og Marty undersøker hvorfor denne ruten kostet så mange menneskeliv.

programme.title: Skjulte hemmeligheter fra 2. verdenskrig
programme.desc: Teamet undersøker Hürtgenskogen i Tyskland for å avdekke skjulte spor etter det lengste og blodigste slaget i USAs krigshistorie.

programme.title: Vinterveiens helter
programme.desc: Norge blir snart truffet av den største stormen på mange år, og bergingslagene må jobbe på spreng for å få alle ned fra fjellet i tide.

programme.title: Togreiser fra oven
programme.desc: Bergensbanen, som går fra Oslo til Bergen, blir filmet fra oven idet toget passerer fjordene på Vestlandet, går opp til den snøkledde Hardangervidda og tar seg gjennom dype skoger. Underveis får vi vite hvordan man jobber for å holde sporet åpent i et utfordrende landskap. De rydder unna snø og is, holder ville dyr på avstand og reparerer skader på togene.

programme.title: Europa fra oven
programme.desc: Den fantastiske reisen gjennom luften viser en helt ny side av Norge. Kameraene avslører ingeniørkunsten bak verdens lengste undersjøiske kabel, svever over huskyer på islagte innsjøer og filmer Norges heldigste postmann på ruten over flere øyer. I tillegg til det fantastiske landskapet som ble formet av isbreer, får vi se den moderne arkitekturen som forandrer Oslos fasade mot vannet.

programme.title: Flyhavarikommisjonen
programme.desc: Like etter å ha tatt av fra Sharm El-Sheikh, styrter et russisk fly. Forkullede rester i Sinai er alt som er igjen av Metrojet 9268.

programme.title: Car S.O.S
programme.desc: Tim og Fuzz tar for seg restaureringen av en britisk lettvekter, en Lotus Elise fra 1997. Bilens eier, den 44 år gamle tidligere trykkeren Sarah, hadde planlagt å få bilen tilbake på veien med hjelp av faren Phil da en dobbel tragedie slo til - han ble offer for uhelbredelig tarmkreft, og dessverre ble Sarah selv også diagnostisert med kreft.

programme.title: Car S.O.S
programme.desc: Tim og Fuzz har reist til Milton Keynes for å prøve å redde Craig sin Ford Model A fra 1930, en historisk bil med en imponerende stamtavle. Bilens eier er den 58 år gamle tidligere elektrikeren Craig, en entusiast som elsker klassiske biler. Han har hatt sin modell A i over 30 år, men etter en tragisk motorsykkelulykke svant planene om å restaurere den da hele hans verden ble snudd på hodet.

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: Når dokumentaren returnerer for sesong nummer to, står Richard overfor den harde virkeligheten at verkstedet fortsatt ikke tjener penger. Men en rask, oppfriskende malingsjobb på en Land Rover gir litt penger i kassa.

programme.title: Vinterveiens helter
programme.desc: Når en fast lastebil blokkerer en hovedvei, må Thord redde den - men sjåføren vil ikke betale, så Thord truer ham med husarrest.

programme.title: Vinterveiens helter
programme.desc: Thord må berge en lastebil som stenger en fjellvei, men samtidig setter utålmodige bilister ham i livsfare.

programme.title: Clarkson's Farm
programme.desc: Det er jul på gården, og Kaleb gir Jeremy en munter overraskelse. Forholdet deres blir anspent mens de krangler under vinterjobbene på gården.

programme.title: Vinterveiens helter
programme.desc: I Overhalla har Raido allerede hendene fulle når han rykker ut til to lastebiler som sperrer hovedveien mellom Nord- og Sør-Norge. Det krevende oppdraget blir enda vanskeligere når en tredje lastebil, på vei mot ulykkesstedet, mister grepet, sklir og sakser på tvers av veien. I fjellene i sør kjemper Bjørn mot stormkastene mens han prøver å berge en lastebil med henger som er blåst av veien. Han må klare oppdraget alene, selv om det egentlig krever et helt bergingslag. Til hans store overraskelse dukker det imidlertid opp uventet hjelp. På et skianlegg skal Thord berge en traktor som henger faretruende ut over en bratt skråning. Den kan styrte ned på luksushytta nedenfor, og Thord tilkaller hele bergingslaget, vel vitende om at den minste feil under bergingen kan få katastrofale følger.

programme.title: Vinterveiens helter
programme.desc: Thord er i gang med å berge en lastebil som sperrer hovedveien, når han får melding om en alvorlig frontkollisjon. Han må bruke all sin erfaring for å berge lastebilen raskt før han setter kursen mot ulykkesstedet. Lenger nord skal Jo Roger berge en gravemaskin som har havnet nede i en ravine ved en liten bekk. Dersom den begynner å lekke olje, kan det få alvorlige konsekvenser for miljøet, så det er ikke rom for feil. Ved en fjord i sør får Bjørn selskap av kona Anette når de skal berge en postbil som har kjørt inn i en fjellvegg før den veltet. For Anette er det en sjelden anledning til å se Bjørn bruke all sin erfaring og kompetanse, og til å hjelpe med bergingsarbeidet der hun kan.

programme.title: Hitlers siste kamp
programme.desc: I september 1944 startet Operasjon Market Garden, historiens største luftbårne angrep. Fallskjermsoldater fra 82. luftbårne divisjon sendes ned langt bak fiendens linjer. Oppdraget deres er å sikre de strategisk viktige broene ved Nijmegen og åpne veien inn i Tyskland. I stedet blir de trukket inn i brutale gatekamper mot tyske SS-styrker som ligger i skjul. Samtidig slår tyske styrker til mot de dårlig forsvarte landingssonene utenfor Nijmegen og setter inn luftvernkanoner. Glidefly med forsterkninger er allerede på vei inn, og amerikanerne har bare minutter på seg før himmelen blir livsfarlig. Underlegen i antall og under konstant ild bryter en av fallskjermsoldatene ut av dekning og stormer kanonstillingene. Han satser alt på et desperat angrep for å redde landingen. Kampen om Nijmegen skal avgjøre skjebnen til Operasjon Market Garden og de alliertes dristige forsøk på å avslutte krigen i 1944.

programme.title: Car S.O.S
programme.desc: Tim og Fuzz går inn i den rare og vidunderlige verdenen til Bond Bug, en heroisk trehjult automotiv fiasko. Bilen tilhører 69 år gamle Ian, hvis drøm om å bli med i en Bond Bug-eierklubb og ta del i samlinger og bilmesser gikk i stå da han fikk Parkinsons. Car SOS-gjengen trår til for å få den merkelige Bugen hans i gang mens han ennå kan nyte den.

programme.title: 2. verdenskrig: Helvete under vann
programme.desc: Juni 1945: Den japanske skipsfarten er bremset ned, og kommandør Eugene Fluckey vedder på at han kan senke 15 av dem.

programme.title: Egypts tapte skatter
programme.desc: Arkeologer avslører hvordan gravrøvere plyndret pyramidene og gravkamrene fra oldtidens Egypt og ledetrådene de etterlot seg. I en nekropolis for eliten etterforsker de et elegant, nedsenket gravkammer, robbet og gjenbrukt i hundrevis av år. De utforsker et av oldtidsverdenens frekkeste ran, et dristig tyveri i et gigantisk og svært beskyttet mastaba-gravkammer. Og ved Egypts eldre pyramide, avslører de hvordan byggearbeidere konstruerte forseggjorte forsvar for å beskytte skattene på innsiden.

programme.title: Egypts tapte skatter
programme.desc: Arkeologene er på sporet av Tutankhamon. For å kartlegge historien leter de gjennom gravkammeret som de første utforskerne ikke fant. Ved steinbruddet hans finner de bevis for et tempel han gjenreiste for å tilbe krokodilleguden Sobek. Under et mystisk fort i ørkenen avdekker de ledetråder om hvordan han samlet nok gull til å fylle gravkammeret med ufattelige skatter.

programme.title: Hvordan fange en smugler
programme.desc: Fra himmelen over San Diego overvåker Homeland Security Investigations flere nivåer av kartellet, og beslaglegger en last på to millioner dollar med narkotika. Tollvesenet og grensepatruljens valuta K9 snuser opp titusenvis i skjulte kontanter i Atlanta. Og i New York avdekker kultureiendomsteamet en smuglerpakke med bøker som viser seg å være over 500 år gamle.

programme.title: Hvordan fange en smugler
programme.desc: Etter å ha funnet fentanyl i passasjerområdet for første gang, gjennomfører toll- og grensepatruljeagenter på JFK spesialoperasjon på alle matbudposer fra Mexico.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: Tunneler kan spare penger, tid og miljøet. De gir en snarvei gjennom uframkommelige landskap, men tunneler i seg selv kan være farlige. I verste fall kan en tunnel bli til en grav. Og dagens tunneler er lengre, dypere og mer dristige enn noensinne. Se nærmere på to europeiske megaprosjekter: den lengste underjordiske jernbaneutgravningen, Brenner Base-tunnelen, og verdens lengste senketunnel, Femern Bælt-tunnelen. Når de slår rekorder og flytter grenser, hvordan kan ingeniører bruke tidligere katastrofer til å gjøre tunnelene tryggere for anleggsarbeidere og bilister?

programme.title: Car S.O.S
programme.desc: For første gang i Car SOS bytter Tim og Fuzz ut fire hjul mot to og tar fatt på sitt hittil mest ambisiøse prosjekt – å restaurere en Triumph Bonneville fra 1973 som tilhører den tidligere postmesteren Ian.

programme.title: Car S.O.S
programme.desc: Tim og Fuzz tar fatt på en Nissan Pulsar GTI-R fra 1990, fast bestemt på ikke bare å restaurere den, men også å finne ut hvorfor det rallyinspirerte ikonet aldri ble den ultimate hot hatch-modellen.

programme.title: Vinterveiens helter
programme.desc: I Overhalla har Raido allerede hendene fulle når han rykker ut til to lastebiler som sperrer hovedveien mellom Nord- og Sør-Norge.
